summary: Add the fs_multinode KV offload tier: persist and restore the CPU primary tier across nodes with node-local disks under multi-node TP
compatibility: No user action required. New opt-in secondary tier type "fs_multinode"; existing tiers are unchanged.
details: Each node persists only its own slots of every chunk row to its own disk; the head runs I/O in the scheduler, other nodes in an agent thread in their local-rank-0 worker, coordinated over ZMQ.
SecondaryTierManager.start_worker_agent (default: no agent) lets a tier start a helper in every worker once the primary region is mapped.
